name: pegass-extractor
description: Extraction de statistiques des bénévoles depuis Pegass (Croix-Rouge française)

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir=. --ignore-files=package.json package-lock.json README.md LICENSE .gitignore .github/** manifest.chrome.json chrome-dist/** scripts/** docs/**
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir=. --artifacts-dir=web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest --filename=pegass-extractor-{version}.zip --ignore-files=package.json package-lock.json README.md LICENSE .gitignore .github/** manifest.chrome.json chrome-dist/** scripts/** docs/**
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --source-dir=. --channel=unlisted --artifacts-dir=web-ext-artifacts --api-key=$AMO_JWT_ISSUER --api-secret=$AMO_JWT_SECRET --ignore-files=package.json package-lock.json README.md LICENSE .gitignore .github/** manifest.chrome.json chrome-dist/** scripts/** docs/**
